story_plan.moment: She plays softly for a rescued kitten as the last tram's lamps emerge through the first snow.
story_plan.meaning: An ordinary wait becomes a small act of companionship; her absorbed attention makes the pause worth keeping.

camera_plan.viewpoint: Low oblique view from the end of the bench, looking toward her profile and the open violin case
camera_plan.optics: An 85mm lens with gentle background compression and credible focus
camera_plan.reason: The low diagonal joins her attentive face, the kitten and approaching lamps without turning the scene into a posed portrait.

choice.world: A fictional riverside city during the first winter snow
choice.scene: An old tram shelter in blue twilight
choice.emotion_tone: Tender absorption and a little reluctant hope as the last tram approaches.
choice.creative_intent: Keep the moment of companionship before departure, with an expressive personal outfit and an intimate off-axis view.

camera_style.name: Snowlight and shelter lamps
camera_style.lighting: Cool snowlight and warm shelter-lamp spill
camera_style.palette: Deep teal, smoky black, amber and pale snow
camera_style.texture: Natural skin, wool weave, velvet pile and fine hosiery pattern
camera_style.framing: A knee-up diagonal with the face, violin case and distant lamps

costume_plan.context_and_climate: A wind-sheltered tram bench in the first winter snow.
costume_plan.role_foundation: A wool travel cape, a wrap skirt and leather ankle boots form her personal cold-evening travel outfit.
costume_plan.feminine_adaptation: Shape the cape waist and open front, contrast a short wrap skirt with delicate patterned stockings and firm boots.

scene_design.subject: A clearly adult East Asian traveler pausing with her violin at a tram stop.
scene_design.setting: An old riverside tram shelter in blue twilight, with first snow caught in amber light.
scene_design.action: Seated on the bench, she draws a slow bow while looking down toward the kitten in her open case.
scene_design.cue1: A rescued kitten curls into the lining of the open violin case beside her.
scene_design.cue2: The last tram's twin lamps approach along rails disappearing into the snowfall.
scene_design.wardrobe: Wool travel cape with a fitted waist and open front; high-waist velvet wrap miniskirt, leather ankle boots and sheer smoky-black stockings with fine floral jacquard and lace tops.
scene_design.composition: Knee-up diagonal linking her face, the kitten and distant lamps.
scene_design.expression: Her eyes soften toward the kitten, with a small absorbed smile she has not noticed.
scene_design.action_physics: Her seated hips rest on the bench; left fingers support the violin neck while her bent right elbow guides the bow.
